Bengaluru police seize narcotics worth over ₹25 crore, arrest 17

Bengaluru police have conducted a crackdown on drug peddling, seizing narcotics valued at ₹25.23 crore. The operation resulted in the arrest of 17 individuals, including three foreign nationals. This action is part of ongoing efforts to combat drug trafficking in the city.
